pair: ENC_HERETIC vs ENC_STOCK (H3, seed 42, 736x1120, 33 frames, 20 steps, audio)
why_it_matters: Heretic was downloaded and wired but never given a paired verdict; both variants are already rendered and archived.

measured.note: pores delta +0.0% is inside noise (<1%); HF and face drift both improve slightly

vision_pair.verdict: Heretic is marginally better on texture and waxiness, both remain very soft, no ringing or blocking in either. Difference is close to the notice threshold.

verdict: Heretic wins slightly and is the default clip_name for H3 renders. The gain is small (-2.5% HF, -2.7% face drift, +1 texture point by vision), so it is not the main lever for skin quality - post-passes and the base model matter more.
